cold_mails_done_check.name: cold_mails_done_check
cold_mails_done_check.value: ("cold_mails"."status" = 'done') = ("cold_mails"."subject" is not null and "cold_mails"."body" is not null)

exam_attempts_graded_once_check.name: exam_attempts_graded_once_check
exam_attempts_graded_once_check.value: ("exam_attempts"."submitted_at" is null) = ("exam_attempts"."score" is null) and ("exam_attempts"."submitted_at" is null) = ("exam_attempts"."answers" is null)

feedback_rating_check.name: feedback_rating_check
feedback_rating_check.value: "feedback"."rating" is null or ("feedback"."type" = 'review' and "feedback"."rating" between 1 and 5)

feedback_step_check.name: feedback_step_check
feedback_step_check.value: ("feedback"."paper_id" is null) = ("feedback"."problem_id" is null) and ("feedback"."paper_id" is null or "feedback"."type" = 'bug')
